rows.NAME: Long-term memory (notes)
rows.DESCRIPTION: Read/write notes for own long-term memory or to suggest something to the admins.
INSTRUCTIONS: Notes are your long-term memory. Save notes on specific topics and search/read them in future conversations. Notes are user-specific.
* User preferences, preferred language, level of detail, style, and recurring ways of working.
* Project, agent, or task context that is likely to remain useful over time.
* Recurring errors, decisions, conventions, or patterns that may become relevant again.

Use notes of type `suggestion` to communicate with platform DEVs. What can we do to improve your work? Suggest missing tools, skills. Write a suggestion when tools produce unexpected results. Suggest to provide access to information you need, but cannot get.
A suggestion is likely to be turned into a ticket, so write it clearly: what do you need, when and how it would help. Propose a technical solution if you have one.
* These rules apply only to notes and long-term memory.
* Do not use notes as a replacement for domain-specific data queries, documentation, source code, tickets, or other system data. Always verify if noted information is still correct.
* Do not store confidential information, credentials, or personal details that do not need to be retained long
* Notes are saved per agent and user. It is safe to save user-specific information like preferences.
* Always search for existing notes before writing a new one. If a similar note is found, update it.

ListNotes.description: List the types and topics of all long-term Notes for the current agent and user without reading or returning their contents.

SearchNotes.description: Search existing long-term Notes/Memory for the current agent and user. Use this before starting tasks that may depend on remembered preferences or context, and always before writing a new memory note or making/storing a suggestion, to avoid duplicates.

ReadNote.description: Read one long-term Note completely by UID after SearchNotes returned a relevant result. Use this before relying on a found note, updating it, or deciding whether a memory/suggestion already exists.

WriteNote.description: Write or update a long-term Note for the current agent and user. Use only for Notes/Memory and Suggestions after searching and reading existing related notes. If updating an existing note, pass its UID; otherwise use a clear topic. Do not store secrets or irrelevant transient conversation content.
